question: When a report updates itself with live data every time we open it, how do we know which numbers to trust?
reflection: Live, shared views of real data can help teams decide together, as long as people still ask where each number comes from.

sources.subject: Moonshot's 2.8T model decodes 6.3x faster at 1M token context

one_line: A Chinese lab announced the largest open model yet, while AI tools in the West focused on live, personal dashboards.

top_stories.title: Moonshot announces a giant open model
top_stories.what: Moonshot AI introduced Kimi K3, a 2.8 trillion parameter model with a very long memory and a new attention design that it says decodes much faster, with open weights promised within days.
top_stories.why: Very large open models give organisations more options to run strong AI on their own infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Claude artifacts now show live data
top_stories.what: Anthropic says apps and dashboards built in Claude Code can now fetch fresh data through connectors each time they open, with each viewer seeing only their own data.
top_stories.why: Small internal dashboards for project tracking could be built quickly without a full engineering team.

top_stories.title: Live 3D maps from ordinary video
top_stories.what: A Chinese research team open-sourced LingBot-Map, which builds 3D maps of a space from a normal video stream in close to real time.
top_stories.why: Cheap 3D mapping could support site studies of public spaces, museums and hospitals.

top_stories.title: Video models hit a physics limit
top_stories.what: A new paper argues that video generation models cannot correctly simulate chain reactions, whatever computing power is added.
top_stories.why: It is a reminder not to treat realistic AI video as a reliable picture of how the world works.

saudi_lens.text: No direct Saudi link today. Live, per-user dashboards are relevant to government digital services that must show each official only the data they are allowed to see.

idea.title: Live fieldwork tracker
idea.pitch: Build a small dashboard that shows survey response counts by region in real time, with access limited by role.
idea.first_step: List the five numbers a project lead checks every day during fieldwork and where each one is stored.

idea_kids.title: Map my room
idea_kids.pitch: Children walk around a room, measure it with string and steps, and build a cardboard 3D model, then compare it with a photo.
idea_kids.first_step: Prepare a worksheet with a grid and a simple key for doors, windows and furniture.

terms.definition: How much text or other input a model can take in and consider at one time.
A connector that lets an AI tool read from or act in another app or data source in a standard way.
A model design where only a few specialised parts are used for each request, which saves computing power.

concepts.summary: New attention designs make very long inputs faster and cheaper.
Connectors let AI-built apps pull live data for each viewer.
Ordinary cameras can now build 3D maps of spaces as they move.
